summary: Backend V1 for UE5 Quinn Auto-Rigger tested end-to-end via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 11 pytest cases passed (health, project CRUD, landmark persistence, template validation for valid/duplicate/orphan/missing cases).

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {ok:true} instead of 204 No Content as suggested in review request (both acceptable, but 204 is REST convention)
Summary defaults landmarks_total to 28 when landmarks list is empty — magic number; consider deriving from active template.bones_count or 0

action_items: Optional: Return 204 No Content on DELETE for stricter REST semantics
Optional: Remove magic-number fallback (28) in list_projects summary — compute from template or return 0
Optional: Migrate deprecated on_event('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan handlers
critical_code_review_comments: Project model uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') — good, prevents Mongo _id from breaking Pydantic parsing (also _id popped in _deserialize).
PATCH does full replace_one after mutating pydantic model — safe but rewrites entire doc every time; fine for V1.
Template validation: orphan check uses `if parent and parent not in names` — passes even if parent is None (root). Correct behavior.
No auth / no rate limiting — expected for V1 desktop-oriented tool; document for later.
server.py is ~260 lines, single-file OK for V1 but split into routers/models/db when V2 features (skinning, export) land.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed projects created and cleaned up within tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (11/11). Frontend Three.js viewport, landmark placement/drag, symmetry mirror, and MongoDB round-trip via UI are still untested. Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression baseline. All API endpoints verified against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
